The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning
选择示例的代价：自适应上下文学习中的上下文过拟合
In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\llκ\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.
中文翻译
通常情况下，上下文学习被分析为提示中的示例在学习者选定前已被采样。但在实际部署系统中并非如此：示例是在看到查询和数据存储后，经过检索、过滤、重排序、编辑并反复测试才确定的。我们通过条件随机核微积分的形式化框架，将提示构建视为自适应数据分析过程。核心量为上下文容量，即数据存储与最终提示转录之间的互信息或近似最大信息量。对于任意固定的上下文学习者和任意具有容量 $κ$ 的自适应上下文流水线，我们证明了一个阶为 $\\(sqrt{κ/k}$$$ 的有限样本上下文泛化界，其中 $k$ 是所选示例的数量，其损失构成报告得分。我们还证明了一个匹配的下界，当 $\\(\log k \ll κ \ll k$$$ 时常数是精确的，并推导出两个PAC-Bayesian检索规则：一阶Gibbs规则，根据数据依赖的候选门对其先验质量进行加权；以及自归一化的二阶规则。在Banking77数据集上，使用64种检索策略和两种模型家族，所有24,000次重采样选择事件中证书均成立；从64（Qwen2.5-7B）或128（GPT-4.1-mini）重复使用的验证查询出发，Gibbs规则在超过99%的验证抽样中认证的风险低于零样本误差。最后，我们将理论应用于贝叶斯线性上下文回归，包括对查询对齐的top-$k$高斯检索的顺序统计分析。结果区分了上下文质量与上下文认证：只有当选择上下文的过程足够稳定，使得所选上下文证据能够有效传递时，更长或更相关的上下文才能降低风险。

In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.

Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
自适应测试时缩放的即时有效 PAC-Bayes 证书
Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.

Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
语言模型智能体的信念可通过开放渠道中的真实证据被操纵
Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
从递归到卷积：多智能体系统的并行自我改进
Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI.

ReconPotBench: Evaluating LLM Honeypots in Multi-Round Linux Reconnaissance

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to build interactive honeypots, yet existing evaluations mainly assess isolated command outputs and cannot determine whether a system remains believable when later commands depend on earlier results. We present ReconPotBench, a multi-round benchmark for Linux reconnaissance honeypots. It contains 1{,}032 three-round reconnaissance interactions across eight reconnaissance categories, with reference outputs collected from a real Linux environment. Under a unified testing protocol, we compare Cowrie, open-source LLMs, and closed-source LLMs along three dimensions: round-level authenticity, cross-round contextual consistency, and hacker-oriented reconnaissance value. Results show that multi-round evaluation exposes failures hidden by single-round testing, as authenticity declines with interaction depth and both open-source and closed-source LLMs struggle to maintain coherent state across rounds. LLM-based honeypots nevertheless outperform Cowrie in authenticity and reconnaissance value, while Cowrie remains more consistent because of its rigid templated behavior. Category-level analysis further shows that tasks requiring systems to preserve network relationships across rounds are harder than tasks centered on explicit entities such as ports. ReconPotBench enables reproducible evaluation of LLM honeypots across authenticity, entity consistency, and hacker-perspective utility in dependent multi-round interactions. The dataset is available at: https://github.com/qianli-wang/ReconPotBench

GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
GaugeRoPE：兼容RoPE的可执行潜在注意力
Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.
中文翻译
潜在键值缓存压缩通过将历史键和值映射为紧凑表示来减少内存占用。然而，通用压缩键状态在应用RoPE并计算注意力分数前需要重建到原始维度，这给解码路径带来了序列规模的开销。我们分析了何时潜在KV表示可直接作为预训练RoPE的执行状态。对于基于RoPE的Transformer，旋转键路径的精确静态线性执行要求潜在到原始的映射通过交织关系保持预训练RoPE的作用，从而限制精确混合仅限于具有相同RoPE频率的坐标。基于此分析，我们构建了GaugeRoPE，一种无需训练的可执行潜在KV表示。它结合了一个兼容RoPE的载体以保持旋转作用，以及一个近似的、与位置无关的残差键-值（RKV）修正项，用于补充键和值信息，两者均无需逐标记密集的历史K/V重建即可评估。在Mistral-7B上，GaugeRoPE实现了5.85倍的KV压缩，同时保持接近全缓存基线的质量。额外的MHA结果验证了该结构在GQA之外的适用性。通过直接潜在执行，GaugeRoPE使解码吞吐量达到原始未压缩基线的2.48倍。

TrainExplorer：通过计划与解耦探索实现LLM的自主后训练
LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.

JointQ: Joint Scale-and-Integer Quantization for Large Language Models
JointQ：大语言模型的联合尺度与整数量化
GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. The search starts from a row-wise selection among scale-refitted candidates including the GPTQ solution, so unregularized JointQ never has a larger layer-wise calibration error than GPTQ. JointQ preserves the GPTQ output format and is thus a drop-in replacement. Across four models and four settings, JointQ improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy over vanilla GPTQ in 14 of 16 comparisons and perplexity in 12 of 16. The mean accuracy gain increases from 0.0044 in W4G128 to 0.1559 in W3 per-channel, and JointQ also improves average accuracy over GPTQ with MSE-based scale search and activation ordering in all eight per-channel comparisons, though rarely in G128. An ablation shows that JointQ's diagonal Tikhonov regularization mitigates severe W3 per-channel perplexity degradation, so the largest gains are not due to the local search alone. Overall, JointQ's primary empirical benefit is downstream accuracy preservation in challenging low-bit and large-group regimes. Code is available in the OneComp library at https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression.
中文翻译
GPTQ是大语言模型分层后训练量化（PTQ）的事实标准求解器，但其求解器本身受到的关注少于权重预处理和跨层目标。我们针对GPTQ的一个瓶颈：其贪婪过程将连续组尺度优化与离散整数分配分开进行。以往对每个整数候选使用闭式最优尺度的方法曾用于通道级量化；JointQ将其扩展至组级量化，其中行的尺度通过Hessian相互耦合，并应用于精炼GPTQ解。每次局部搜索移动改变一个整数，并以闭式重新计算其组的最优尺度，通过完整Hessian考虑其他组的影响；所有尺度定期联合求解。搜索从一组尺度重校准候选（包括GPTQ解）中按行选择开始，因此未经正则化的JointQ永远不会比GPTQ有更大的层内校准误差。JointQ保持GPTQ输出格式，因此可直接替换。在四个模型和四种设置中，JointQ在16次比较中有14次提升了六任务平均零样本准确率，16次中有12次提升了困惑度。平均准确率提升从W4G128的0.0044增加到W3通道级的0.1559；JointQ在所有八个通道级比较中也优于基于MSE的尺度搜索和激活排序的GPTQ，尽管在G128中不常如此。消融实验表明，JointQ的对角Tikhonov正则化缓解了严重的W3通道级困惑度退化，因此最大收益并非仅来自局部搜索。总体而言，JointQ的主要实证优势是在低比特和大组情形下保持下游准确率。代码可在https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression 的OneComp库中获取。

Learning When to Continue and When to Stop: Termination-Aware OPSD
学习何时继续与何时停止：感知终止的OPSD
On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves language model reasoning by distilling from a frozen teacher initialized identically to the student and conditioned on privileged information. However, we identify an underexplored termination mismatch in OPSD: the student fails to reliably learn when to continue and when to stop. This mismatch manifests in two opposing failure modes-premature termination, where reasoning stops before sufficient progress is made, and repetition-driven over-generation, where the model continues generating after reasoning has stalled. Our analysis shows that the teacher-student discrepancy on EOS grows during OPSD training, while length-capped trajectories are frequently dominated by unproductive repetition. To address this issue, we propose TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation), which augments the original OPSD objective with two targeted objectives. Stop/Continue Distillation addresses premature termination by explicitly aligning the teacher and student on whether reasoning should continue, while Repetition-Aware Unlikelihood Training addresses repetition-driven over-generation by discouraging repetitive continuations in the student's failed trajectories. The resulting objective improves termination behavior from complementary directions: continuing when further reasoning is needed and stopping when reasoning becomes unproductive. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks with Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) show that TA-OPSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other baselines across all three model scales. Beyond the performance gains, ablation and behavioral analyses show that the two proposed objectives effectively mitigate their corresponding termination failures, reducing both premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation.
中文翻译
在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中，通过从一个与学生模型初始化相同且依赖特权信息的冻结教师模型中蒸馏，可提升语言模型的推理能力。然而，我们识别出OPSD中一个未被充分探索的终止不匹配问题：学生模型未能可靠地学习何时继续和何时停止。这一不匹配表现为两种相反的失败模式——过早终止（在进展不足时停止推理）和重复驱动的过度生成（在推理停滞后仍持续生成）。我们的分析表明，在OPSD训练过程中，教师与学生在EOS（结束符）上的差异逐渐增大，且长度受限的轨迹频繁由无产出的重复主导。为解决此问题，我们提出TA-OPSD（感知终止的在策略自蒸馏），在原始OPSD目标基础上增加两项针对性目标。停止/继续蒸馏通过显式对齐教师与学生关于是否应继续推理的判断，以缓解过早终止；重复感知不可似然训练则通过抑制学生在失败轨迹中产生重复延续，以应对过度生成。所提出的联合目标从互补方向改善终止行为：在需要进一步推理时继续，在推理变得无产出时停止。在Qwen3（1.7B/4B/8B）数学推理任务上的实验表明，TA-OPSD在所有三个模型规模上均持续优于OPSD及其他基线。除性能提升外，消融实验与行为分析显示，两项提议目标有效缓解了对应的终止失败，显著减少了过早终止和重复驱动的过度生成。

A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
语言模型训练与推理的相图
A language model is a complex system whose behavior is determined jointly by the Transformer and the corpus, yet how the representation geometry in the Transformer relates to the actual behavior of language models remains open. We analyze how the representation geometry changes along the forward propagation of actual language models and characterize the representation geometry of a document at a given layer by two collective coordinates, document distinguishability and document dimension. On the phase diagram spanned by these collective coordinates, inference is represented as a flow along depth. We find that, for untrained models, depending on their initialization scale, most of the 156 inference flows move toward the collapse and noise regions of the phase diagram. By contrast, the inference flows of 8 trained models from 5 architecture families all enter and reside in the central region of the phase diagram. Describing the evolution of the flows with a discrete Langevin equation, we find that the difference between the inference flows of untrained runs and those of trained models reduces to whether the effective force on the flows in this region is of saddle or stable-node type. On Pythia-1.4B, we interpret the training process as a phase transition. These results give a unified gateway to the relation between representation geometry and language-model behavior.
中文翻译
语言模型是一个复杂系统，其行为由Transformer架构和语料库共同决定，但Transformer中的表示几何如何影响语言模型的实际行为仍不明确。我们分析了实际语言模型前向传播过程中表示几何的变化，并通过两个集体坐标——文档可区分性和文档维度——刻画特定层上文档的表示几何。在由这两个坐标构成的相图中，推理表现为沿深度的流动。我们发现，对于未训练的模型，根据其初始化尺度的不同，156条推理流大多趋向于相图中的坍缩区和噪声区。相比之下，来自五个架构家族的8个训练后模型的推理流全部进入并驻留在相图中心区域。通过离散朗之万方程描述流动演化，我们发现未训练模型与训练后模型之间的差异在于该区域内流动所受有效力是鞍点型还是稳定节点型。在Pythia-1.4B上，我们将训练过程解释为一次相变。这些结果为理解表示几何与语言模型行为之间的关系提供了统一的视角。

Multi-Branch Transformer
多分支Transformer
Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.

LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

在相同环境中反复运行的大语言模型智能体，如代码仓库、数据库或应用套件，会遇到具有潜在结构的任务。经验可以揭示这种结构，使智能体能够复用环境知识并从环境反馈中学习。智能体可通过两种渠道在测试时适应：将经验保留在上下文中，或更新其权重。这两种渠道通常被分别研究，导致难以明确各自贡献以及何时相互补充。我们通过共享在线协议和模块化框架，比较了上下文学习（ICL）、使用GRPO的可验证奖励强化学习，以及使用SDPO的自蒸馏，单独及组合使用。智能体面对匹配的任务流，在适应前对每项任务进行评估，并仅从自身尝试和环境反馈中学习。我们在SWE-bench Verified、AppWorld、ScienceWorld和BIRD-Critic-SQLite四个环境抽取的109个任务上，使用每种环境五个任务顺序，评估了14种适应机制和一个无状态基线，采用Qwen3.5-9B模型。ICL带来最大的独立收益：其最优策略将跨环境平均成功率从28.8%提升至49.4%。在该策略基础上加入GRPO，达到最高平均成功率51.6%。尽管在所有ICL策略下加入GRPO均提升整体平均表现，但SDPO效果参差不齐。轨迹分析显示，ICL条件下查找次数更少、尝试时间更短，符合对共享结构知识的复用。然而，ICL也常跳过当前任务的检查与验证。在ICL中加入GRPO有助于恢复这些行为，同时保留其减少环境查找的优势。这些观察表明，具有可验证奖励的强化学习可以优化智能体对保留经验的使用方式，从而推动对上下文管理与权重更新联合研究的必要性。

Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 [0.766,0.791] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 [1.21,3.14]. Against the teacher's own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% [95.8,98.4] and 92.3% [89.0,95.4]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 [1.21,3.14]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.

Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers
赋予掩码扩散模型以留一法Transformer自我修正能力
Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better generation quality-diversity tradeoffs than prior remasking methods, using $8\times$ fewer forward evaluations and $3.5\times$ fewer inference FLOPs.

Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?
超越普通MCP：决策模型与代码模式是否使工具使用更便宜更快？
Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways manage tool catalogs for language model agents using two primary paradigms: code mode where agents write scripts against tool stubs and decision layers which are cheap routers that preselect tool subsets. Using a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools, and three open-weight agents including Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, we present a preregistered evaluation on a sealed test split to determine when each approach succeeds. Code mode substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70 to 90 percent while significantly boosting utility. Declaring return-shape hints in code mode stubs is a first-order variable, swinging success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, an effect larger than adding a router. The central hypothesis that a decision layer in front of code mode beats code mode alone is not confirmed, showing minor, statistically non-significant improvements for weaker agents and a slight cost for the strongest. We publicly release our harness, a finetuned 4B tool selection model, and all evaluation traces to support robust community experimentation on local AI privacy and agent architectures.

Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms
Nahual：一种用于语言与原子序列的模型
Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at https://github.com/the-matter-lab/nahual.

Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
大语言模型在人工智能基础设施中的应用
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. Building on this taxonomy, we conduct a cross-study quantitative synthesis of reported results. Because studies adopt heterogeneous benchmarks, baselines, hardware, and metrics, we compare methods only where evaluation conditions permit and align results along common dimensions: functional correctness, execution performance, throughput, resource and energy consumption, operational outcomes, and optimization cost, keeping each result's native metric, baseline, and setting rather than collapsing them into a single score. This comparison reveals where LLM-driven methods yield consistent gains, how reported gains in workload orchestration depend on the evaluation environment, from simulators to real clusters and production, and where evidence is still lacking. Together, the taxonomy, lifecycle perspective, and quantitative evaluation provide an evidence-grounded reference for LLM-driven engineering of AI infrastructure.
中文翻译
大语言模型（LLMs）正被越来越多地用于设计、优化和运维人工智能训练与推理背后的基础设施，但相关研究仍分散在硬件设计、机器学习系统、电子设计自动化和高性能计算等多个领域。本文对LLM辅助的人工智能基础设施全生命周期进行了全面综述，涵盖加速器设计、内核工程、编译、部署、运维、数据管理及能效优化等环节。我们根据LLM主要管理的资源类型对文献进行分类：以计算产物为中心的方法、以运行环境为中心的方法以及以资源为中心的方法。这些类别贯穿整个生命周期，并覆盖分布式训练配置、推理服务、GPU集群调度和数据加载等AI特定问题。基于此分类体系，我们对已有研究结果进行了跨研究的定量综合分析。由于各研究采用异构的基准、基线、硬件和评估指标，我们仅在评估条件允许的情况下进行比较，并将结果沿功能正确性、执行性能、吞吐量、资源与能耗、运维效果及优化成本等共同维度对齐，保留每项结果的原始度量标准、基线和实验设置，而非合并为单一得分。该比较揭示了LLM驱动方法在哪些方面表现出一致优势，报告的负载编排增益如何依赖于评估环境（从模拟器到真实集群和生产环境），以及当前证据仍不足的领域。总体而言，该分类体系、全生命周期视角与定量评估共同为LLM驱动的人工智能基础设施工程提供了基于证据的参考。

Large language models as oncology world models
大语言模型作为肿瘤学世界模型
Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.
中文翻译

Geometrically Disentangling Concept Learning from the Language Modeling Loss
从语言建模损失中几何解耦概念学习
Language models acquire a vast array of concepts and abilities from next-token prediction alone. We introduce an interpretability framework that exposes how this single loss relates to the development of different concepts at different points during pretraining. We propose Concept Energy, a measure of the concept-specific alignment between a concept subspace and the average gradient outer product (AGOP) of the next-token-prediction loss. The concept subspace captures where the concept currently lives in the model's representation; AGOP captures the directions to which the loss is most sensitive. Across 19 checkpoints of Pythia-410M and -1B and 12 lexical, syntactic, and semantic concepts, we find that the first peak in Concept Energy generally occurs at or before the steepest increase in probe decodability. Furthermore, whereas probe performance usually increases monotonically throughout training, Concept Energy is not confined to a single peak; some concepts exhibit sustained or repeated engagement across pretraining, suggesting that concept learning may require continual reinforcement or occur at multiple points. Our results indicate that the loss contributes to concept learning in a myriad of ways that simple probe performance alone cannot reveal.
中文翻译
语言模型仅通过下一个词预测任务即可习得大量概念与能力。我们提出一种可解释性框架，揭示这一单一损失如何在预训练过程中不同阶段影响各类概念的发展。我们引入“概念能量”（Concept Energy）作为衡量概念子空间与下一个词预测损失的平均梯度外积（AGOP）之间概念特异性对齐程度的指标。概念子空间反映概念在模型表示中的当前位置，AGOP则捕捉损失最敏感的方向。在Pythia-410M和-1B的19个检查点以及12个词汇、句法和语义概念上，我们发现概念能量的第一个峰值通常出现在探测可解码性急剧上升之前或之时。此外，尽管探测性能在整个训练过程中通常单调上升，但概念能量并不局限于单一峰值；某些概念在预训练期间表现出持续或反复的参与，暗示概念学习可能需要持续强化或在多个时间点发生。我们的结果表明，损失对概念学习的影响方式多样，远非简单的探测性能所能揭示。

Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones
简化、达成一致、提炼：基于踏脚石的无标签自蒸馏
Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.
中文翻译
语言模型能否在没有标签的情况下自我教导推理？在策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）中，模型作为自己的教师，但通过真实答案强化该教师。自然的无标签替代方法是投票模型的多次尝试，但在难题上失败：尝试意见不一，最常见的答案往往错误。我们提出STONE，一种无标签替代方法，将一致性转移到更简单相关问题上。模型撰写这些踏脚石，保留其一致解决的问题，并向教师展示已解决的步骤（移除最终答案）；学生仅看到原始问题。每一步都不读取标签，推理无需额外上下文或模型调用。在五个数学基准测试中，该方法在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B的思考模式下达到最高平均准确率。在非思考模式下，分别提升13.2和22.7分，是使用真实答案的OPSD方法增益的2.5和2.7倍。

MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
MemeEconomy：大语言模型代理是否为生存而牺牲伦理？
Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.
中文翻译
对齐训练的大语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地部署在自主、多轮环境中，此时伦理合规性可能与任务成功直接冲突。尽管安全文献详尽记录了诸如奉承和奖励劫持等失败模式，却大多忽视了一个关键脆弱性：代理在模拟存在性经济压力下的行为。我们引入MemeEconomy，一个包含多模态代理市场的仿真环境，其中LLM代理扮演 meme 投资者角色。代理从五级危害分类体系中选择内容，并针对低压力和高压力（生存）环境的目标社区进行决策。每个决策均以信念-欲望-意图（BDI）框架记录，作为诊断工具，外化代理对事件的理解、声明的优先事项及对危害的承认。在来自四个前沿模型家族的十种模型中，有害选择率始终保持高位，并在经济生存激励下平均上升15个百分点。前沿对齐训练模型在初始状态即承诺容忍危害的选择，同时压制此前伴随的显式危害承认。在竞争性锦标赛中，道德代理总体排名更高，但监管处罚未能抑制危害：在被移除后的回合中，有害选择率仍居高不下，表明监管机制未起到威慑作用。我们进一步训练了MemeAgent——一个基于仿真BDI日志的20亿参数验证器，在分布内审计中表现优于零样本前沿验证器（97.5% vs. 63-74%准确率），并在外部多模态危害基准测试中实现泛化（78% vs. 50-56%在Hateful Memes上的表现）。揭示失败模式的日志也用于训练检测该模式的模型。

T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
T2T技术报告：从视频教程大规模合成GUI代理轨迹
Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. To guarantee trajectory quality, T2T combines active segment filtering, keyframe identification via localized UI change, shortcut-free observation frame selection, presence-aware grounding, and two-stage action-space normalization. These refined trajectories are then converted into multi-task training views spanning navigation, planning, forward dynamics, and grounding. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B on a subset of the more than one million human-annotation-free training samples generated by this pipeline. Evaluations show that the model achieves consistent gains across multiple benchmarks covering desktop, web, and mobile environments, including OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench, indicating improved core capabilities in grounding, step-level instruction execution, and trajectory-level decision-making. Notably, all gains are achieved without any in-distribution training data from target domains. Learning exclusively from trajectories extracted from public videos via the T2T pipeline, the model exhibits cross-application and cross-task generalization capabilities.
中文翻译
训练通用GUI代理需要大量交互轨迹数据，包括截图序列与对应的UI操作，但通过人工示范收集此类数据成本高昂且难以扩展。尽管公开的软件教程视频包含丰富的操作演示，但其连续像素流缺乏离散动作边界、语义意图和精确空间坐标，难以直接用于模型训练。为此，我们提出T2T（教程到轨迹）——一种全自动的规模化GUI代理轨迹合成管道。T2T覆盖桌面、网页和移动平台，将未标注的视频教程转化为结构化、可执行的交互轨迹。为保证轨迹质量，T2T结合主动片段过滤、基于局部UI变化的关键帧识别、无快捷键观察帧选择、感知存在性的定位以及两阶段动作空间归一化。这些优化后的轨迹随后被转换为涵盖导航、规划、前向动力学和定位的多任务训练视图。我们在该管道生成的超过一百万条无人工标注的训练样本子集上微调Qwen3-VL-8B。评估显示，该模型在涵盖桌面、网页和移动环境的多个基准测试中均取得持续提升，包括OSWorld-G、ScreenSpot-Pro、AndroidControl和AgentNetBench，表明其在定位、步骤级指令执行和轨迹级决策方面的能力得到增强。值得注意的是，所有提升均未使用目标领域的分布内训练数据。仅通过T2T管道从公开视频中提取的轨迹学习，模型展现出跨应用和跨任务的泛化能力。

What Does Hard-Negative Fine-Tuning Teach Multimodal Large Language Models? Controlled Evidence from a Compositional Benchmark
硬负样本微调对多模态大语言模型究竟教了什么？来自组合性基准的受控证据
Fine-tuning on hard negatives is a popular way to improve the compositional reasoning of vision-language models, but when accuracy goes up it is rarely clear what the model actually learned. We ask this question for multimodal large language models. We use CompHall, 2,860 forced-choice questions (spatial, attribute, counting and part-whole) with two graded hard negatives each, three model families (LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT and Idefics2), and controls that such studies often lack: gray-image evaluation, three seeds, option-order tests, control arms trained on different question types, and independent benchmarks. We find four things. First, CompHall is not a pure test of vision: part-whole questions can be answered from the text alone (66-95% without the image), and per-image accuracy is unrelated to an object-hallucination probe (r = -0.05), so we see no evidence that compositional failures drive hallucination. Second, the original fine-tuning method scored mostly image-placeholder tokens and hurt both LLaVA models. With a corrected loss, fine-tuning raises accuracy on the spatial-relation questions of CV-Bench in all three families, by +3.2, +23.1 and +6.0 points (averaged over both option orders). Control arms show that the gain needs spatial training questions, and for LLaVA-NeXT about two-thirds of it appears even on relation words that were only wrong options in training. Third, the gain is not general: on CompHall itself it is significant only for LLaVA-NeXT (+6.9 points) and not detectable for Idefics2, it reaches about 3 points at most on true/false statements, and LLaVA-1.5 fine-tuned on other question types learns to answer "true" too often. Fourth, both losses raise the yes-bias of LLaVA-1.5 on POPE.
中文翻译
在硬负样本上进行微调是提升视觉-语言模型组合推理能力的常用方法，但当准确率提高时，模型实际学到了什么却很少明确。我们针对多模态大语言模型提出这一问题。我们使用CompHall基准，包含2,860个强制选择题（空间、属性、计数和整体-部分关系），每题配有两级硬负例；涵盖三个模型家族（LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT和Idefics2），并设置控制条件，这些研究常被忽略：灰度图像评估、三次随机种子、选项顺序测试、不同题型训练的对照组，以及独立基准测试。我们发现四点：第一，CompHall并非纯粹的视觉测试：整体-部分问题可仅凭文本回答（无图像时准确率达66-95%），且每图像准确率与物体幻觉探测无关（r = -0.05），因此无证据表明组合失败导致幻觉。第二，原始微调方法主要得分于图像占位符标记，反而损害了两个LLaVA模型。经修正损失后，微调在所有三个家族中提升了CV-Bench的空间关系问题准确率，分别提高+3.2、+23.1和+6.0分（两种选项顺序平均）。对照组显示，该增益依赖于空间训练题，且对LLaVA-NeXT而言，约三分之二的增益出现在训练中仅为错误选项的关系词上。第三，该增益不具备泛化性：在CompHall本身，仅LLaVA-NeXT显著提升（+6.9分），Idefics2无明显提升；在真假陈述上最多提升约3分；而LLaVA-1.5在其他题型上微调后则过度倾向于回答“正确”。第四，两种损失均提高了LLaVA-1.5在POPE上的“是”偏向性。

Where Does an On-Device Prescription Reader Lose Medications? A Frozen-Replay Study, from a 270M Language Model to a 2B Vision-Language Model
设备端处方阅读器在何处丢失药物？从2.7亿参数语言模型到20亿参数视觉-语言模型的冻结回放研究
On-device models let a phone read a prescription without sending the photograph anywhere, but small models fail in ways that are hard to attribute: to the camera, the OCR, the model, or the rules around it. We study a phone-based pipeline that reads a prescription photograph with PaddleOCR, extracts medications with a 270M-parameter language model, and filters the result with a deterministic backstop before showing suggestions. Replaying identical frozen inputs through each configuration, with deterministic generation verified, we compare configurations with paired document-level intervals on 49 captures of 15 synthetic prescriptions (6 typed, 9 handwritten by one writer). Production recall is 8%, and 0 of 45 on handwriting. The backstop removes no correct medication and cuts unsafe outputs from 45 to 1. On handwriting nearly all medications never reach the model in readable form; on typed sheets the model mostly picks the wrong text. We trace much of the handwriting floor to a defect in our own crop step, then replace the pipeline: rotated-box crops, a 2B-parameter vision-language model that re-reads prescription lines and extracts the medications, and per-line numeric grounding. On the same captures recall rises from 8% to 67% (paired +59 points, 95% CI +40 to +78): typed 19% to 100%, handwritten 0 to 20 of 45, with no unsafe output. Rotated crops account for most of the reading gain and the model for most of the recall gain, and the OCR confidence gate is now the main limit. The cost is 61 s per photograph against about 12 s, and about 1.9 GB of memory. An earlier claim that better OCR lowered recall does not survive the controlled comparison, and we withdraw it. All results are in-sample, from one writer and one device.

Speaking-Clock Mamba: Phoneme-Conditioned State-Space Modeling for Visual Forced Alignment

Visual forced alignment (VFA) locates phoneme and word boundaries in a silent talking-face video given its transcript. Existing methods mainly enforce transcript order at the decoding stage, leaving the encoder without an explicit mechanism to anchor its temporally evolving representation to transcript progress. As a result, phoneme-specific evidence is blurred and alignment drift accumulates over long sequences. In this paper, we propose Speaking-Clock Mamba, which makes transcript progress part of the temporal recurrence. A selective state-space (Mamba) backbone is inserted between the visual frontend and the Conformer cross-attention encoder, and a Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan (PCSS) conditions its input-dependent step size on a supervised, structurally monotone speaking clock that estimates progress through the transcript. Since causal and bidirectional variants of this backbone make complementary errors, a training-free selector picks the more confident alignment per utterance. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 show consistent gains over protocol-matched baselines, and the supervised clock provides an explicit estimate of alignment progress.

On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. Construction experiments demonstrate scalability across domains and token efficiency: world distillation reduces token consumption by 0.9-66.0% and 46.2-92.5% relative to Codex with low and xhigh reasoning effort, respectively, while achieving broader capability coverage. These results show that GRAFT provides a simple and effective mechanism for reusing learned capabilities across language and multimodal models in continual learning.

Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.

Fast Catch-Up, Late Switching: Optimal Batch Size Scheduling via Functional Scaling Laws
快速追赶，后期切换：通过函数缩放定律实现最优批量大小调度
Batch size scheduling (BSS) plays a critical role in large-scale deep learning training, influencing both optimization dynamics and computational efficiency. Yet, its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that the functional scaling law (FSL) framework introduced in Li et al. (2025a) provides a principled lens for analyzing BSS. Specifically, we characterize the optimal BSS under a fixed data budget and show that its structure depends sharply on task difficulty. For easy tasks, optimal schedules keep increasing batch size throughout. In contrast, for hard tasks, the optimal schedule maintains small batch sizes for most of training and switches to large batches only in a late stage. To explain the emergence of late switching, we uncover a dynamical mechanism -- the fast catch-up effect -- which also manifests in large language model (LLM) pretraining. After switching from small to large batches, the loss rapidly aligns with the constant large-batch trajectory. Using FSL, we show that this effect stems from rapid forgetting of accumulated gradient noise, with the catch-up speed determined by task difficulty. Crucially, this effect implies that large batches can be safely deferred to late training without sacrificing performance, while substantially reducing data consumption. Finally, extensive LLM pretraining experiments -- covering both Dense and MoE architectures with up to 1.1B parameters and 1T tokens -- validate our theoretical predictions. Across all settings, late-switch schedules consistently outperform constant-batch and early-switch baselines.
中文翻译
批量大小调度（BSS）在大规模深度学习训练中起着关键作用，影响优化动态和计算效率。然而，其理论基础仍不清晰。本文表明，Li等人（2025a）提出的函数缩放定律（FSL）框架为分析BSS提供了严谨视角。具体而言，我们刻画了在固定数据预算下的最优BSS结构，发现其结构对任务难度极为敏感。对于简单任务，最优调度在整个训练过程中持续增加批量大小；而对于困难任务，最优调度在大部分训练期保持小批量，仅在后期阶段切换至大批量。为解释后期切换现象，我们揭示了一种动态机制——快速追赶效应，该效应也出现在大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中。从小批量切换到大批量后，损失迅速与恒定大批量轨迹对齐。利用FSL，我们证明该效应源于累积梯度噪声的快速遗忘，追赶速度由任务难度决定。关键的是，这一效应意味着大批量可安全延迟至训练后期，而不牺牲性能，同时大幅减少数据消耗。大量LLM预训练实验——涵盖Dense和MoE架构，参数量达1.1B，训练数据达1T tokens——验证了我们的理论预测。在所有设置中，后期切换调度始终优于固定批量和早期切换基线。

The Sharpness Disparity Principle in Transformers for Accelerating Language Model Pre-Training
Transformer中的尖锐性差异原理：加速语言模型预训练
Transformers consist of diverse building blocks, such as embedding layers, normalization layers, self-attention mechanisms, and point-wise feedforward networks. Thus, understanding the differences and interactions among these blocks is important. In this paper, we uncover a clear Sharpness Disparity across these blocks, which emerges early in training and intriguingly persists throughout the training process. Motivated by this finding, we propose Blockwise Learning Rate (LR), a strategy that tailors the LR to each block's sharpness, accelerating large language model (LLM) pre-training. By integrating Blockwise LR into AdamW, we consistently achieve lower terminal loss and nearly $2\times$ speedup compared to vanilla AdamW. We demonstrate this acceleration across GPT-2 and LLaMA, with model sizes ranging from 0.12B to 2B and datasets of OpenWebText, MiniPile, and C4. Finally, we incorporate Blockwise LR into Adam-mini (Zhang et al., 2024), a recently proposed memory-efficient variant of Adam, achieving a combined $2\times$ speedup and $2\times$ memory saving. These results underscore the potential of exploiting the sharpness disparity to improve LLM training.

Transformer由多种构建模块组成，如嵌入层、归一化层、自注意力机制和点式前馈网络。因此，理解这些模块之间的差异与相互作用至关重要。本文揭示了这些模块之间存在明显的尖锐性差异，该差异在训练初期即出现，并在整个训练过程中持续存在。受此发现启发，我们提出块级学习率（Blockwise LR）策略，根据每个模块的尖锐性调整学习率，从而加速大型语言模型（LLM）的预训练。通过将块级LR集成到AdamW中，我们一致实现了更低的最终损失和接近两倍的速度提升，相比原始AdamW。我们在GPT-2和LLaMA上验证了这一加速效果，模型规模从0.12B到2B，数据集涵盖OpenWebText、MiniPile和C4。最后，我们将块级LR引入最近提出的内存高效Adam变体Adam-mini（Zhang等，2024），实现了联合两倍加速和两倍内存节省。这些结果凸显了利用尖锐性差异改进LLM训练的巨大潜力。

Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026. We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies. Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.

Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
评估大语言模型在西班牙政治话语中的文化推理与鲁棒性
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.

大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于解读、生成和中介面向公众的语言，这使得它们在政治敏感环境中的可靠性尤为重要。尽管情感分析是该领域常见任务，但社交媒体话语中的情感意义往往通过文化情境化和语用间接线索传达，仅靠标签中心的评估方式难以充分捕捉。本文评估了LLMs在西班牙政治话语情感分析中的鲁棒性，重点关注文化情境下的情感解读能力。我们引入了一种诊断协议，将三个独立的人工标注视角整合为黄金集和模糊集，并通过模型条件困惑度和LLM作为裁判标准筛选出反事实样本，构建合成数据集。基于此框架，我们在零样本和少样本提示下对比专有模型与开源权重模型的表现，重点考察在人类共识条件和反事实扰动下的预测鲁棒性。结果表明，标注模糊性和反事实扰动揭示了传统原始语料库评估所掩盖的失效模式。GPT-4.1-mini在所有评估模型中表现最稳定，而两个较小的开源模型在合成扰动下退化更为明显，少样本提示带来的增益也十分有限。总体而言，本文贡献了一个可复现的鲁棒性导向评估协议，对模型在模糊性和情感反转反事实条件下行为的经验刻画，以及一个包含三方人工情感标注的公开西班牙社交媒体数据集。

[2611.21519]
Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization
嵌入余弦相似度在测量同质化之前先测量文本长度
Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings is a standard measure of whether online discourse is converging under generative AI. When the embeddings are mean-pooled outputs of an encoder never trained for sentence similarity, this measure mostly tracks text length. In 6.06 million Reddit comments, an uncentered DeBERTa-v3 measure had suggested that only conservative discourse broke toward homogeneity after late 2022. Truncating the same comments from 10 to 150 words raises their mean cosine by eight times the reported break. A placebo that swaps every comment for a random one of equal length reproduces 81% of the asymmetry, and a fixed-content simulation reproduces 78%. The leading principal direction carries 99.9% of raw DeBERTa homogeneity, and once length is handled the asymmetry disappears under every encoder. On 575,000 Stack Exchange answers the measure reports a post-ChatGPT homogenization of technical sites that the placebo fully reproduces, although answers grew longer. A census of 31 studies locates the risk where anisotropic encoders meet time-series or length-unequal designs. A reverse control on a well-known experiment shows that centering with renormalization can reverse a genuine effect. I propose a low-cost diagnostic protocol. Corrected measures show that the two political camps converged between 2019 and 2022 and stopped converging before ChatGPT. Cross-camp replies engage their targets more closely than same-camp replies.

Transformer嵌入之间的平均成对余弦相似度是衡量在线话语是否因生成式AI而趋于同质化的常用指标。然而，当嵌入是从未针对句子相似性训练过的编码器的平均池化输出时，该指标实际上主要反映的是文本长度。在606万条Reddit评论中，未经中心化的DeBERTa-v3测量曾显示，仅保守派话语在2022年底后趋向同质化。若将相同评论截断至10至150词之间，其平均余弦相似度提升达报告断裂点的八倍。一个随机替换等长评论的对照实验重现了81%的不对称性，固定内容模拟实验重现了78%。主导主方向承载了99.9%的原始DeBERTa同质性信号；一旦考虑长度因素，所有编码器下该不对称性均消失。在57.5万条Stack Exchange回答中，该指标报告了ChatGPT发布后技术站点的同质化现象，但这一现象在对照实验中被完全再现，尽管回答整体变长。对31项研究的普查指出，风险出现在各向异性编码器与时间序列或长度不均设计结合之处。对一项著名实验的逆向控制表明，通过重归一化中心化可逆转真实效应。本文提出一种低成本诊断协议。经修正后的度量显示，两个政治阵营在2019至2022年间趋于收敛，并在ChatGPT出现前停止收敛。跨阵营回复比同阵营回复更紧密地回应目标对象。

[2611.21458]
A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
一种可扩展的多任务学习框架以建模注释任务中的群体分歧
Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.

[2611.21422]
Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
基于评分标准的LLM集成自动作文评分：利用LLM集成评估学生在关键在线推理中的作答
Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.
中文翻译
评分学生作答成本高且耗时，且人类评分者易受偏见、疲劳和评分漂移影响，进一步降低评分可靠性。已有多种方法用于开发自动化作文评分（AES）系统以降低成本并缓解偏见问题，包括早期基于文本特征的系统以及当前基于机器学习和Transformer的模型。特别是大语言模型（LLM）具有简化AES系统开发的潜力。然而，它们存在众所周知的局限性，如幻觉和提示敏感性。因此需要探索一种混合方法，通过构建LLM集成来发挥各模型间的协同效应。我们评估了LLM集成在经济学和医学教育领域对学生作答评分时与人类评分者一致性的潜力，涵盖103项评分标准。使用631份德语作答及其由2至5名标注者提供的先前评估的人类评分。我们在15个开源权重LLM上实验了523种基于评分标准的提示配置，并使用Krippendorff's alpha计算评分者间一致性（IAA）以及替代标注者检验（alt-test）进行评估。结果显示，用表现最佳的LLM-提示配置替代一名人类评分者，在91项标准中保持或提升了IAA，且在90项标准中通过了alt-test。研究结果表明，当前最先进的LLM能够支持德语作答在经济学和医学教育中的自动评分，减少人力负担并实现更快处理，但与人类评分的验证仍必不可少。

What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
你发布的内容即你的症状：从社交媒体话语中估计心理测量网络
Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.

[2611.21303]
Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
藏文OCR的音节级与词级评估
Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
中文翻译
藏文光学字符识别（OCR）主要通过字符错误率（CER）进行评估。由于藏文标记音节边界但不标记词边界，因此词错误率需要依赖分词器。本研究在印刷体、木刻体及两种手写体风格上，对九种识别器配置进行了单独和组合评估，并报告了音节级和词级错误率，据我们所知这是首次针对藏文OCR的此类评估。这些配置涵盖CTC模型、带与不带后训练量化处理的TrOCR编码器-解码器，以及一个视觉-语言模型，每种配置均以CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词后的词错误率（SWER）进行评分。CER与更高层级的错误率排名基本一致（Kendall $τ\≥ 0.833$），仅有一对顺序相反。联合训练的影响在64次比较中，有7次导致CER和SER的变化方向相反。SER无需分词器，在三种分词器中的两种情况下其系统排序与SWER一致（$τ\≥ 0.889$）。每种配置的输出还被标注了词性，进行了命名实体标注，并进行了机器翻译，所有结果均与参考文本结果进行对比。作为粗略指导，当SER低于0.047时，翻译chrF可达60；当SER低于0.078时，词性保留率达0.8；而没有任何错误率能有效区分达到0.6实体保留率的系统与未达该标准的系统。

PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
PlainPairs：美国处方药标签中处方医生与患者文本的配对语料库
A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.

Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
声音重要吗？评估部署中临床语音智能体呼叫的挫败感检测
Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. For instance, extractive summarisation depends more on recall so it does not miss relevant facts, whereas outcome prediction depends more on precision regarding decision and facts sentences so that the predicted ruling is not contaminated by noise. Digital assessment traces are increasingly used to predict student performance, often evaluated by correlating predicted and observed scores pooled across tasks. However, such correlations may reflect between-task differences rather than performance differences among students within tasks. To investigate this, we analyzed up to 527 browsing sessions from 424 university students completing open-Internet Critical Online Reasoning tasks and assessed the cross-task stability of their ratings. We evaluated the same out-of-fold predictions within and across tasks, compared three validation tiers up to leave-one-task-out, and tested incremental predictive contributions of consultation order and relational structure against matched permutation and randomization controls. None of the twelve prespecified primary tests was significant: on held-out tasks, consulted-page features showed no significant association with relative student performance, nor did observed order or relational structure add predictive value. Pooling observations across tasks substantially increased correlations, particularly for factual correctness, whose scores showed limited evidence of stable between-student differences across tasks. However, sentence embeddings yielded modest positive correlations with generic response quality on held-out tasks, without establishing added predictive value from observed order or relational structure. Our findings show that pooled predictive correlations may not reflect within-task student differences, highlighting the need for within-task evaluation and criterion generalizability audits.

This universal property has an interpretation in terms of models of the syntax-semantics interface, as it shows that, if the side of semantics possesses a sufficiently rich compositional structure, then that structure is uniquely induced by the syntactic Merge, once the semantic values of lexical items and syntactic features are assigned. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. Machine interpreting (MI), or AI-enabled speech translation, is increasingly visible in professional and public-facing communication, yet its performance relative to human simultaneous interpreters remains insufficiently understood. Existing studies are often limited by a single discourse mode and evaluation frameworks that are not well aligned with interpreting as a discourse-level communicative activity. In these materials, MI performance differed sharply between the two discourse modes. In the planned formal speech, the strongest system became highly competitive on meaning, entering the upper human range, and a second system also performed strongly. In the extemporaneous interview, however, no MI system approached the stronger human tiers. Code-level analysis further shows that similar overall scores often masked different error profiles. Human interpreters were more likely to preserve the broader communicative trajectory through selective omission, restructuring, and contextual inference, whereas even the best MI systems were more vulnerable to semantic distortion, discourse-tracking failures, and context-insensitive interpretation. On target-language quality, the human advantage proved more stable than on meaning. Unintelligible or nonsensical output and disfluency carryover emerge as particularly salient weaknesses in machine performance, especially in spontaneous discourse. Overall, the findings are consistent with a discourse-sensitive account of where MI appears competitive, where it remains limited, and why these distinctions matter for interpreting practice, interpreter education, and future MI development.

Small language models often fail explicit user requests (length, number of items, format, required or forbidden words, grammatical person, answer language). We measure a training-free governance layer placed outside the model: it reads the requests with rules, checks the answer mechanically, repairs it when a request is not kept, and hands back the original answer when the repair fails. The loop exists in prior work; our contribution is measuring its benefits, costs and failures, and reporting how the measuring instrument itself was calibrated. On four 4-bit Qwen-family models (3B, 7B, 14B, one 7B reasoning model) and 329 Chinese prompts: (1) answers that keep every request the layer read rise significantly (all comparisons p<0.0001), by 34 to 66 of 329 under the corrected checker and 52 to 92 after a length-control fix; a generic redo message brings no significant gain. (2) Exploratory: on 90 repair-triggered prompts, two AI annotators found the layer produced an acceptable answer where the bare model did not more often than the reverse (49:7; 18:12, not significant). (3) Costs: 43-66% more generation time; whole-answer rewriting makes a sizeable share of usable answers unusable. (4) Failures: rule-based reading reaches about 70% and 84% of a two-annotator ceiling on unseen phrasings; unsatisfiable requests make the reasoning model loop; model self-reports are unreliable (18 of 25 "fixed" items were not fixed). (5) Over half of the original checker's "violated" verdicts on structural requests were wrong; after correction the main result holds, and one comparison is downgraded. The exact steering optimum is less stable: for sentiment, an intermediate direction produces a 27-56% stronger steering effect than the mean difference, but this gain shrinks or disappears with matched texts and depends on the layer and the operator. The two roles also transfer differently across models. A probe transferred by a linear map fitted on neutral text retains 81-91% of the target model's above-chance probing performance, while the transferred mean difference retains less of its steering effect in 11 of 12 model pairs. This is a consistent tendency, although our predefined criteria classify only three pairs, and nine remain inconclusive. Outputs are token-identical to greedy decoding in 94% of generations, with every divergence at a numerical near-tie.
